question: Should Delete on a missing key become idempotent (nil) per the issue wording, or keep the existing ErrKeyNotFound behavior the CLI relies on?
Switch Set/Get to []byte per the issue's proposed signatures, or keep the existing string-based Store interface?
Add optional Exists(key) (bool, error) convenience method in this issue, or defer it?
Is there remaining implementation work, or is every AC already satisfied by main — implement just re-verifies existing tests?
Should implement add an explicit concurrent-access test under go test -race to demonstrate the concurrency-safety AC?

dispositions.summary: New TestMemoryStore_ConcurrentAccess only catches locking regressions when run with `go test -race`; CI's Test step runs `go test ./...` without `-race`, so the test can't enforce the concurrency-safety AC in CI going forward
